title: Jake Barber's book Sentinels of Ether partly redacted
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jake Barber's book Sentinels of Ether partly redacted, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jake Barber wrote a book called Sentinels of Ether and he came out with the first chapter of the book and it was 20 pages. Seven pages of that book were redacted by subject matter experts for some reason

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jake Barber, a man who has spoken publicly about UFOs, wrote a book called Sentinels of Ether. According to Michels, when Barber released the first chapter, 20 pages long, seven of those pages had been blacked out by government subject matter experts, for reasons not given, which would suggest the material touches on something officials want kept quiet.
